data.name: OAuthClientApplication_Help
data.value: Registers an external application that may request OAuth authorization and tokens.

data.name: OAuthClientApplication_Description
data.value: Defines the redirect locations, grants, scopes, resources, security controls, and credentials available to an OAuth client.

data.name: OAuthClientApplication_ClientId_Help
data.value: Globally unique OAuth identifier presented by the client.

data.name: OAuthClientApplication_ClientType_Help
data.value: Public clients use PKCE and cannot safely hold a secret. Confidential clients authenticate at the token endpoint.

data.name: OAuthClientApplication_Status_Help
data.value: Controls whether the authorization server accepts requests from this client.

data.name: OAuthClientApplication_ClientSecret_Help
data.value: Credential for confidential clients. The plaintext value is stored in secure storage and is not persisted with this record.

data.name: OAuthClientApplication_RedirectUris_Help
data.value: Exact callback locations to which authorization responses may be sent.

data.name: OAuthClientApplication_PostLogoutRedirectUris_Help
data.value: Allowed destinations after a logout flow completes.

data.name: OAuthClientApplication_AllowedGrantTypes_Help
data.value: OAuth grants available to this client, such as authorization_code and refresh_token.

data.name: OAuthClientApplication_AllowedScopes_Help
data.value: Permissions this client is permitted to request.

data.name: OAuthClientApplication_AllowedResources_Help
data.value: Resource servers for which this client may request access tokens.

data.name: OAuthClientApplication_RequirePkce_Help
data.value: Requires proof-key validation for authorization-code exchanges.

data.name: OAuthClientApplication_RequireConsent_Help
data.value: Requires the user to approve the requested access.

data.name: OAuthClientApplication_IdentityTokenLifetimeMinutes_Help
data.value: Optional client-specific ID-token lifetime. Leave empty to use the authorization server default.

data.name: OAuthClientSettingValue_Help
data.value: A configured OAuth value such as a redirect URI, grant, scope, or resource.
